style.backgroundSystem: seamless off-white #FDFDFD for packshot and comparison, icy periwinkle-mist field #E8EAF4 for benefit, scene, spec and trust, deep slate panels #4A5178 for the pain split, deep navy-slate backdrop #3E4668 reserved for the texture macro, one full periwinkle #8C94C6 field only for the closing screen
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused cool studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars, one soft pink-tinted rim reserved for the macro
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft-cool personal care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of icy periwinkle-mist #E8EAF4, misty periwinkle blue #8C94C6, deep navy-slate #3E4668, off-white #FDFDFD and one cherry-blossom pink accent #E9A6B6; soft diffused cool studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end soft-towel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the draw-pack across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte icy-blue stone vanity counter #E8EAF4 and flat matte display plinths in #FDFDFD, one low matte periwinkle plinth #8C94C6
